cells.rationale: The 10-year yield was at 4.99% on Oct 27 and 4.986% on Oct 26, on a three-week declining trend from above 5.3% in early October, making it currently below the 5.00% threshold. For the Oct 30 print to exceed 5.00%, it would need to rally at least 1 bp from current levels, which is within normal 3-day volatility (10-15 bp std dev), but the downward momentum argues against it. The FOMC meeting and GDP/PCE releases in the window are the main wildcards—a hawkish surprise could push it above 5%, but the market expects no change and the base case is continued stability or slight decline below 5%.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
